text: {"label":"Learning in Nontraditional Animal Species","definition":"Basic research and reviews on conditioning, choice, discrimination, and punishment in fish, invertebrates, birds, and other uncommon species, plus comparative questions about animal learning across species.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on basic learning in uncommon species such as zebrafish, bees, and planaria, not on applied training of dogs and other animals, primate studies, or pigeon research."}
